components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: separators are stripped, a leading '+'
            keeps the supplied country code otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped, and the result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. For example '0412 345 678' is stored and
            returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-30'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Optional and write-only; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when the owner joins a
                household (created with 'sharesHousehold' true against an
                existing owner who has the same last name and address). All
                owners in the same household share this value. Null when the
                owner does not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level assigned at creation,
                ranging from 1 to 3. It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email
                address is present, gains 1 when the owner had no namesakes at
                creation (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this
                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup surge;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:

      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: separators are stripped, a leading '+'
            keeps the supplied country code otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped, and the result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. For example '0412 345 678' is stored and
            returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-30'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Optional and write-only; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when the owner joins a
                household (created with 'sharesHousehold' true against an
                existing owner who has the same last name and address). All
                owners in the same household share this value. Null when the
                owner does not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level assigned at creation,
                ranging from 1 to 3. It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email
                address is present, gains 1 when the owner had no namesakes at
                creation (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-

                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup surge;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean

              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-

              type: string
              enum:

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
